source: fontjoy.com homepage shipped HTML (hardcoded demo), fontjoy.com/pairing/ (method), Jack000/fontjoy readme and formula.png
formula: contrast similarity = -N * P, where P = sum over i of A_i*B_i with A_i*B_i > 0 and N = sum over i of A_i*B_i with A_i*B_i < 0. With N <= 0 and P >= 0 this equals |N| * P, so the score is large only when a pair is similar in some dimensions and different in others in equal measure.

homepageDefault.note: curated default in the shipped homepage HTML (data-family/data-variant); all three faces are present in the 2017 vector set. Low ranks under the pairwise metric signal that the selection model is still incomplete (TSK-009: legibility weighting plus joint 3-slot optimization), not that the example is meaningless.
